fixes: Removed visible variant/numeric suffixes
Removed underscores from visible prompts
Regenerated Dutch article questions as natural definite-article questions with two options
Added prompt ttsText for math operators, so hyphen/minus is read correctly
Added shape answer speak metadata so buttons read the shape name only
Regenerated repeated world knowledge questions
Regenerated writing prompts without underscore blanks
Kept time, measurement, and geometry_shapes under Geometry
Reworked reading exercises as visual word recognition instead of revealing the word in the prompt
Added visualSources with emoji icons and localized alt labels for reading exercises
Changed reading exercise type to visual_word_choice so the app shows the icon below the prompt and answer buttons contain the words
Removed the separate vocabulary/woordenschat subcategory because vocabulary is covered in World knowledge
Regenerated reading exercises with curated, accurate object icons and reduced target duplication per grade
Regenerated writing exercises as Dutch missing-letter exercises with a yellow question-mark marker
Writing prompts no longer reveal ellipses or answer lists; they show patterns such as k ? t
Writing TTS reads the full Dutch word/letter sequence, not a blank or question mark
Writing answer values are the actual letter/letter group, not correct/wrong labels and not words such as een
Missing-letter prompt question marks are normal text; only the separate missing marker is yellow.

Listening letter/sound exercises include audio/@phoneticText and audio/@ttsText for reliable pronunciation.
Writing answer options include speak metadata so letters/clusters like a, aa, ui and eu are read correctly.
Added five metric comparison subcategories under Measurement and geometry: bigger/smaller, heavier/lighter, higher/lower, longer/shorter, and farther/closer.
Added Question words under Spelling and grammar with which, what, how, when, where, who, why, and how many.
Refined visible category labels to Reading and listening, Spelling and grammar, and Measurement and geometry in nl-BE, en-US, and fr-BE.
Preserved existing serialized learning-domain and progress identifiers for backward compatibility.
qualityFixes: Removed visible Choose from / Kies uit / Choisis parmi option lists from prompts
Rewrote missing-letter prompts so they show the full word and a pronounceable bleep pattern instead of ellipsis
Formatted large visible numbers with spaces as thousands separators
Added/kept math ttsText so minus is read as min/minus/moins instead of a dash
Regenerated world knowledge prompts to avoid repeated adjacent questions such as thirsty/water
Kept answer values canonical and localized displays for UI rendering
Reading visual_word_choice exercises use visualSources with accurate emoji icons and no visible word labels
Writing missing_letter_choice exercises include missingLetterDisplay markerColor #FFD700
Removed vocabulary subcategory from language XML and index
Removed the missingMarkerColor top-level attribute from writing exercises to avoid coloring the prompt question mark.
Added markerColor only to missingLetterDisplay metadata.
Added displayValueMustBeUsed=true to short letter/sound answers to prevent showing canonical or stale values such as een.
Corrected generated nl-BE/en-US comparison wording and Belgian French contractions without changing exercise IDs or progress keys.
fixesInThisVersion: Communicatie/Luisteren and Schrijven/Schrijven no longer use raw single-letter text for TTS.

audio/@text is now also safe phonetic text for these subcategories, with rawValue/targetValue preserving the literal answer value.
